messages:
Maria (CSM): Hi all — kicking off Arcadia Health first sprint. Target: staging integration by day 7, pilot with 50 internal users by day 30. Need owners for: infra, metrics, enablement, and compliance. Any major blockers?

Aisha (CS Ops): High-level success signals from ops: daily active users >= 15 in pilot, error rate < 1.5%, and cost per 1k tokens within agreed budget. Renewal risk if DAU < 10 at 45 days. Suggest we track weekly adoption and a weekly pulse survey.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll take infra + integration. Need staging API key, sample anonymized patient snippets, and confirmation of whether Arcadia wants streaming responses. My timeline: smoke test by day 3, end-to-end by day 7.

Priya (Product): I'll own acceptance criteria and product sign-off. For pilot, recommend a quantized model with a separate higher-capacity model for escalation. I'll also define the three core flows to validate (summary, triage suggestion, and embedding search).

Oliver (Enablement): I'll run two drop-in sessions: developer walkthrough (20m) and clinical admin walkthrough (30m). Also happy to make a 1-page cheat sheet and a short video. Prefer dev session on day 2 and admin on day 9.

Maria (CSM): Proposed owners: infra = Ravi, metrics = Aisha, enablement = Oliver, product sign-off = Priya. I'll add these to the customer board and set recurring checks.

Aisha (CS Ops): Risk flags: if usage is concentrated on <=2 users it's a red flag. Also capture qualitative feedback via in-app thumbs + optional one-question form after sessions. I'll create the pulse survey.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): For creds — @Arcadia will need a restricted staging key and a short-lived dev key for early trials. Example curl to share: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer STG_KEY_ABC" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"summarize intake: [redacted]"}' \
  https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/chat```. Can infra provision STG_KEY_ABC?

InfraBot: staging-key: STG_KEY_ABC provisioned and shared to arcadia-secured channel (expires in 30 days).

Priya (Product): I'll post the three core flow test cases to the board by EOD and add expected outcome criteria.

Oliver (Enablement): I'll draft the cheat sheet and a short sample prompt set. Also need example failure modes from Arcadia for training; Maria, can you request those?

Maria (CSM): Yes — I'll ask Arcadia for 5 example failure scenarios and a contact for sample data. Also: let's define retention policy for staging logs. Aisha — preference?

Aisha (CS Ops): Recommend 90 days for retention but ensure PHI/PII is stripped. Documented on compliance checklist and require Arcadia sign-off on sanitized dataset.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): One technical question: do we enable prefix caching for session flows or keep stateless calls for pilot? Caching boosts performance but may complicate evaluation.

Priya (Product): Start stateless for pilot, enable caching in week 2 if performance issues arise. We'll note in rollout plan.

Maria (CSM): Action list: (1) Ravi: smoke test day 3 + e2e day 7; (2) Aisha: pulse survey + dashboard setup by day 5; (3) Oliver: materials + sessions scheduled; (4) Priya: test cases + sign-off criteria. Please ack with ETA.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Ack — smoke test tomorrow (1746098745), e2e by day 7 (1746620745).

Aisha (CS Ops): Ack — dashboard + survey by day 5.

Oliver (Enablement): Ack — draft cheat sheet by day 3, sessions scheduled.

Priya (Product): Ack — test cases posted today.

InfraBot: staging-deploy: environment ready at staging.arcadia.redwood.internal. Logs retention set to 90 days (sanitization flag ON).

Maria (CSM): Great — I'll monitor adoption metrics and run weekly 30-min syncs on Mondays. Closing thread for now; will move updates to the board. :rocket:
